GPTR-F-002-S46.title: Token Schema and Persistence Model
GPTR-F-002-S46.description: Define and implement a token data model including token_id, issued_at, expires_at, status (active/revoked), and scope. Persist tokens in a secure store and integrate with existing auth validation flow.
GPTR-F-002-S46.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; GAP: No persistent token lifecycle schema currently defined

GPTR-F-002-S47.title: Token Expiration and Validation Logic
GPTR-F-002-S47.description: Implement expiration checks in bearer token validation flow. Reject expired tokens at request time and ensure all GPTReader endpoints enforce expiration consistently.
GPTR-F-002-S47.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; GAP: Expiration enforcement not implemented

GPTR-F-002-S48.title: Token Rotation Mechanism
GPTR-F-002-S48.description: Implement token rotation workflow allowing issuance of new tokens and graceful invalidation of prior tokens. Support overlap window if required for active sessions.
GPTR-F-002-S48.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: No rotation mechanism exists for GPTReader tokens
